assets.name: clay-buttress
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated modular cliff buttress for a high-end cartoony tropical platform game. A single SOLID chunky rock formation built from three fused, oversized angular rock masses. Clear broad planar cliff faces, pronounced rounded bevels, a wide stable foot, a taller slanted central face and one lower side shoulder. Every surface is clean smooth matte clay with extremely subtle broad color gradients: warm grey stone, soft pale edges, cool muted grey-green recesses. The top has a small smooth green turf cap, like green clay, NOT individual grass or leaves. Large defined forms with polished sculpted edges, sophisticated stylized AAA game art. NO tiny chips, NO grunge, NO cracks or black crevices, NO holes or perforations, NO photographic rock textures, NO separate shards, NO foliage. Closed solid object with a simple back suitable for embedding in a larger island. Entire object visible in three-quarter orthographic studio view on a neutral grey background. About 12m wide, 18m tall, 10m deep. No text, no ground pedestal, no water, no scene or island.

assets.name: clay-terrace
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated modular exposed cliff terrace for a high-end cartoony tropical platform game. A wide SOLID rock ledge, three oversized connected angular masses forming two stepped terraces. Broad strongly defined vertical and sloping stone planes with generous rounded chamfers, asymmetric silhouette, wide foot and a flat rear that can embed into a mountainside. Soft clay-like finish, low-contrast grey-taupe rock color gradients with pale warm edges and cool grey-green lower faces. A simple continuous green clay turf cap covers the two upper ledges. This is an exaggerated clean stylized solid sculpture, NOT a realistic scan. NO small chips, no surface noise, NO black cracks, NO holes, no floating fragments, NO tiny grass or leaves, no texture patterns. Three-quarter orthographic product render, full isolated module on neutral grey, gentle studio lighting. Roughly 22m wide, 11m tall, 12m deep. No text, no water, no island monolith, no base pedestal.
